The public Release exposes identity-bound archives, SHA256 checksums, SBOM, provenance, and release manifest.
Public adopter and N-1 acceptance use only downloaded immutable artifacts, prove isolation and temporary-root cleanup, and preserve first-adopter-smoke=not_ready.

The Work Item has visible Outcome, archive, finalization, close, exact branch/worktree cleanup, and no active residue before publication.
goal: Prepare, publish, install, and post-release-accept v0.2.61 with identity-bound evidence and exact governance cleanup.
intent: Publish the next reviewed Rust Runtime patch release and prove the immutable public binary before resuming reference comparison.
